audit.whatIsWrong: The page tells you to 'wall his exit path the moment he dives' and to bait 'his sidestep tool'. Lux has no dash, no blink and no mobility of any kind, and she never dives.
audit.why: Her kit is four skillshots — Light Binding 1175, Prismatic Barrier 1150, Lucent Singularity 1100, Final Spark 3340. She is the most immobile champion in the lane and wins purely on range.
audit.corrected: This is a range problem, not a dive problem: she reaches 1100-1175, you reach 1075. Stand behind minions until Glacial Storm, and spend Crystallize on the poke line and gank paths rather than on an escape she never makes.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0..3].side all read 'Skill' while win[0..3] read 'Lux' and packet.levelChart reads Lux for those same four rows.
audit.why: The page renders two different answers to who wins Levels 1 through 5. The content layer and the packet agree with each other and with a 52.1% Anivia win rate driven entirely by scaling.
audit.corrected: phases[0..3].side = Lux, matching win[0..3]. Spikes: her Light Binding rank-ups and Final Spark at 60s falling to 40s; yours are Lost Chapter, level 6 Glacial Storm, then Seraph's/RoA.

audit.whatIsWrong: Prismatic Barrier is never mentioned anywhere on the page, and Final Spark's 3340 range is never connected to Rebirth.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags the shield explicitly: it absorbs the burst window that Anivia's entire trade pattern (chilled E for double damage) depends on, and it is only 12s at rank 1. Separately, Final Spark reaches 3340 from off-screen and Rebirth leaves you as a stationary egg — the two facts belong on the same page and neither is there.
audit.corrected: Force Prismatic Barrier out before committing; it is 12s. Do not treat the egg as insurance against a champion who can hit it from 3340 range without approaching.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names one ability and gives no numbers.
audit.why: Light Binding is 10s flat, Lucent Singularity 10s at rank 1, Prismatic Barrier 12s, Final Spark 60s at rank 1 — those four numbers are the whole sequencing story.
audit.corrected: Numbers written in, plus the fact that Light Binding stops at the first two units it touches, which makes minion-blocking a hard answer rather than a hope.

audit.whatIsWrong: Lux is referred to as male in tldr, winCon, tradeGood, tradeBad, loading, both don't titles and the wave text.
audit.why: Wrong pronoun throughout a page about a champion the reader is looking at.
audit.corrected: Feminine pronouns in every rewritten field.
